title: Ingrid
creator: CrossFit
description: Ten rounds of 3 snatches at 135/95 lb and 3 burpees over the bar. Grettel's twin from the 2021 batch of Girls, with snatches in place of clean and jerks; the same 30 lifts as Isabel, broken up by burpees. Scale the load to keep the snatches crisp.
